shortDescription: The DAX Index rose 164 points or 0.63 percent on Thursday to close at 26003 points.Leading the gains are Volkswagen (3.38%), Porsche Automobil (2.68%) and Vonovia (2.46%).Top losers were Rheinmetall (-2.07%), Fresenius Medical Care (-1.93%) and Qiagen NV (-1.85%).
